S^A | Schwartz and Architecture
San Francisco, CA | Full-Time | 3–5 Years of Experience
About S^A
S^A | Schwartz and Architecture is an award-winning architecture and interiors studio based in San Francisco. Our small, collaborative team is committed to thoughtful, site-sensitive, and high-quality design across a diverse range of projects.
We foster a casual, supportive studio environment that values creativity, collaboration, and attention to detail. We are committed to mentorship and professional growth, offering opportunities for team members to take on increasing responsibility and leadership within the firm.
The Position
We are seeking a talented and motivated Architectural Designer with 3–5 years of professional experience to join our team.
The ideal candidate has exceptional design, graphic, and technical skills, strong attention to detail, and an enthusiasm for working collaboratively. As part of our small studio, you will have the opportunity to contribute to a variety of projects, gain broad-based experience across all phases of design and construction, and work closely with the firm's principals and design team.
